briefings.tldr: Google DeepMind SVP and Chief AI Architect Koray Kavukcuoglu joins host Logan Kilpatrick to discuss the journey from early reinforcement learning milestones to Gemini, the breakthrough of agentic coding, and Google's unwavering commitment to building AGI at the frontier.
